ios_min_version.description: Oldest iOS build still allowed. Users below this see a non-dismissible force-update screen. Leave empty to disable.

ios_latest_version.description: Current App Store version. Users below this see an optional update alert. Leave empty to disable.

defaultValue.value: A new version of Kharcha is available with improvements and fixes.

ios_update_message.description: Message shown in the optional update alert (Update / Not Now).

defaultValue.value: This version of Kharcha is no longer supported. Please update to continue.

ios_force_message.description: Message shown on the mandatory full-screen update block.

App Update.description: Controls optional and mandatory in-app update prompts for iOS. Set version strings to activate; leave empty to disable.
